content.comment_body: Hello, I'm experiencing a similar issue with [product_name] V[version_no] not starting—it closes just a few seconds after launching. Is there a recommended solution? I tried using GODMODE, but I am unsure if that helped. Thank you, [user_name]

Hello, First, do not use "god mode" as it can interfere with Java functioning. Next, ensure you installed the correct software type: use 64-bit on a 64-bit Windows system and 32-bit on a 32-bit system. This mismatch is a common mistake when downloading the installer. Also, verify that Java is enabled, updated, and matches the 64 or 32-bit version of your OS. Avoid using an upgrade pack and make sure you have installed the full version of the software.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are having trouble launching [product_name] V[version_no], as the program shuts down almost immediately after startup. Attempts to resolve the issue by elevating permissions did not help, and could affect Java's operation. Another user identifies mismatched installation types (64-bit vs 32-bit) and outdated or incorrect Java installations as likely causes. There is a clear need for better installation and troubleshooting guidance, especially regarding compatibility and Java requirements.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the software to start correctly without shutting down and look for clear troubleshooting instructions to resolve compatibility and setup issues easily.
